$comment: HIC 27.09.2026: catalogue-wide managed delivery contract templates, one per implementation chapter (docs/plans/PRODUCT_PRODUCTION_READINESS_PROGRAM.md). Shared, factual, chapter-level templates — never 138 independent claims. Managed human delivery is the stated fallback for every chapter; no chapter claims unattended automation. Consumed by scripts/truth/apply-product-delivery-contracts.mjs.

Chapter 1.team: Lifetime Oy — SME Web & IT Services Team
Chapter 1.deliveryMode: Managed human delivery: scoped, built and handed over by a named delivery engineer; no unattended automation claimed.
Chapter 1.acceptanceCondition: Buyer receives the agreed deliverable (site, store or support hours) matching the order scope, on the agreed delivery date.
requiredOutcomes: Deliverable matches the scoped order (pages, store, or support hours) confirmed in writing
Buyer sign-off recorded before the engagement is marked complete
exclusions: Content, imagery or copy not supplied by the buyer within the agreed intake window
Ongoing hosting, maintenance or content updates beyond the scoped engagement
Third-party licence or subscription costs (domains, plugins, apps)

Chapter 2.team: Lifetime Oy — Consulting, Engineering & Training Team
Chapter 2.deliveryMode: Managed human delivery: a named consultant or trainer delivers the engagement in person or remotely; no unattended automation claimed.
Chapter 2.acceptanceCondition: Buyer receives the agreed session, workshop or engagement deliverable and confirms it matches the scoped agenda.
requiredOutcomes: Scheduled session or engagement delivered within the agreed window
Deliverable (report, code, training material or transcript) handed over and buyer-acknowledged
exclusions: Work beyond the agreed hours, days or scope without a separate order
Travel costs outside Finland/EU unless separately quoted
Implementation of recommendations beyond the engagement itself

Chapter 3.team: Lifetime Oy — DWS IQ Platform Team
Chapter 3.deliveryMode: Managed cloud or on-premise provisioning by the platform team; human-verified activation. No unattended automation claimed for first deployment.
Chapter 3.acceptanceCondition: Buyer can log in to a provisioned DWS IQ tenant matching the ordered tier, with the documented agent/user limits active.
requiredOutcomes: Tenant or deployment provisioned and reachable within the delivery window
Documented tier limits (agents, users, capacity class) verified active
Buyer receives onboarding confirmation
exclusions: Custom connectors or integrations beyond the documented tier
Data migration from a prior system unless separately quoted
Usage beyond the documented capacity limits for the ordered tier

Chapter 4.deliveryMode: Managed on-site or hybrid deployment with human oversight throughout; kill authority and audit logging verified by a named engineer before handover.
Chapter 4.acceptanceCondition: The ordered Aegis/KYA scope is deployed, its audit logging is verified writing locally, and an operator can invoke kill authority.
requiredOutcomes: Deployment reaches the ordered scope (pilot, implementation phase, or subscription entitlement)
Article 12 audit logging verified writing locally
Operator kill authority verified functional
exclusions: Hardware procurement (quoted and delivered separately)
Scope beyond the single ordered site/workflow unless separately ordered
Integrations with systems not named in the order

Chapter 5.deliveryMode: Managed SaaS tenant activation with human-verified configuration; no unattended automation claimed for first activation.
Chapter 5.acceptanceCondition: Buyer's Firehorse tenant is active with the ordered module enabled and a first workflow run completed successfully.
requiredOutcomes: Firehorse tenant/module active within the delivery window
First workflow run completed and buyer-visible
Buyer receives activation confirmation and access credentials
exclusions: Source-system integrations not named in the order
Historical data backfill beyond the documented onboarding scope
Custom report templates beyond the ordered package

Chapter 6.team: Lifetime Oy — Sovereign Hardware & Edge Team
Chapter 6.deliveryMode: Managed hardware fulfilment: procurement, shipping and (where ordered) on-site installation by a named engineer.
Chapter 6.acceptanceCondition: Buyer receives the ordered hardware in working condition, powered on and passing a basic functional check.
requiredOutcomes: Hardware shipped and received within the quoted lead time
Unit powers on and passes a basic functional check
Installation (where ordered) completed and signed off
exclusions: Software/NIM/Kubernetes stack licensing beyond the hardware itself
Site preparation (power, network, rack space) not supplied by the buyer
Extended warranty or on-site support beyond the standard manufacturer term

Chapter 7.team: Lifetime Oy — Kubernetes, DOCA & NIM Team
Chapter 7.deliveryMode: Managed cluster/service provisioning by a named engineer on buyer-supplied or Lifetime-supplied hardware; human-verified before handover.
Chapter 7.acceptanceCondition: The ordered cluster tier or service is provisioned, reachable, and passes the documented capability check for that tier.
requiredOutcomes: Cluster or service provisioned within the delivery window
Documented tier capabilities (operators, hardening, DPU services) verified active
Buyer receives access and a handover note
exclusions: Underlying compute hardware unless separately ordered
NVIDIA AI Enterprise or third-party subscriptions billed separately
Multi-cluster or multi-site scope beyond the ordered tier

Chapter 8.team: Lifetime Oy — Compliance, Safety & Materials Agents Team
Chapter 8.deliveryMode: Managed agent activation: a named engineer configures and activates the ordered agent tier; human review of first output before buyer handover.
Chapter 8.acceptanceCondition: The ordered agent tier is active, has processed at least one buyer-supplied case, and a human has reviewed the output before handover.
requiredOutcomes: Agent tier activated within the delivery window
First buyer case processed and reviewed by a named engineer
Buyer receives the reviewed output and an activation confirmation
exclusions: Source-system integrations not named in the order
Coverage of regulations or jurisdictions outside the documented scope
Fully unattended operation — outputs are human-reviewed before delivery in this managed-delivery phase

Chapter 9.team: Lifetime Oy — Operations & Assurance Agents Team
Chapter 9.deliveryMode: Managed agent activation: a named engineer configures and activates the ordered agent; human review of first output before buyer handover.
Chapter 9.acceptanceCondition: The ordered agent is active, has processed at least one buyer-supplied case, and a human has reviewed the output before handover.
requiredOutcomes: Agent activated within the delivery window
First buyer case processed and reviewed by a named engineer
Buyer receives the reviewed output and an activation confirmation
exclusions: Source-system integrations not named in the order
Fully unattended operation — outputs are human-reviewed before delivery in this managed-delivery phase

Chapter 10.team: Lifetime Oy — Growth, Knowledge & Viability Agents Team
Chapter 10.deliveryMode: Managed agent activation: a named engineer configures and activates the ordered agent; human review of first output before buyer handover.
Chapter 10.acceptanceCondition: The ordered agent is active, has processed at least one buyer-supplied case, and a human has reviewed the output before handover.
requiredOutcomes: Agent activated within the delivery window
First buyer case processed and reviewed by a named engineer
Buyer receives the reviewed output and an activation confirmation
exclusions: Source-system integrations not named in the order
Fully unattended operation — outputs are human-reviewed before delivery in this managed-delivery phase

Chapter 11.team: Lifetime Oy — Function & Channel Bundles Team
Chapter 11.deliveryMode: Managed bundle composition: a named engineer activates each required component agent and verifies the bundle's aggregate scope before handover.
Chapter 11.acceptanceCondition: Every component agent required by the bundle is active and the bundle's documented aggregate scope is verified by a named engineer.
requiredOutcomes: All required component agents active within the delivery window
Aggregate bundle scope verified against its documented composition
Buyer receives a bundle activation confirmation
exclusions: Any component agent not part of the documented bundle composition
Fully unattended operation — the bundle is human-verified before delivery in this managed-delivery phase

Chapter 12.deliveryMode: Managed industry-pod onboarding: a named engineer configures the pod's shared agents against buyer industry data and verifies one witnessed outcome before handover.
Chapter 12.acceptanceCondition: The industry pod is onboarded, configured against buyer data, and one witnessed outcome scenario has been completed and reviewed.
requiredOutcomes: Pod onboarded and configured within the delivery window
One witnessed outcome scenario completed and reviewed by a named engineer
Buyer receives the reviewed outcome and an onboarding confirmation
exclusions: Coverage of industry scenarios not named in the order
Fully unattended operation — outputs are human-reviewed before delivery in this managed-delivery phase

Chapter 13.deliveryMode: Managed advisory programme: a named programme lead runs the weekly-gated engagement; human review at every gate before proceeding.
Chapter 13.acceptanceCondition: The programme reaches its first weekly gate with buyer-reviewed inputs and a documented go/no-go decision.
requiredOutcomes: Programme kicked off within the delivery window
First weekly gate reached with a documented go/no-go decision
Buyer receives the gate review and next-step recommendation
exclusions: Scope beyond the named programme's documented weekly gates
Implementation work outside the programme's own chapter (wrapped, not duplicated)

acceptanceRule: All listed required outcomes must be met. Delivery follows the chapter managed-delivery process described in fulfilment.deliveryMode; unattended automation is not claimed unless documented separately for this SKU.
